title: Absolutely Free Short-Drama Streaming Sites
criterion: No coins, no payment, no VIP tier, no subscription, no locked episodes
method: Fetched the final episode of a series per site; confirmed a working player renders; scanned served HTML and JSON schemas for lock/currency/login mechanisms.

free.evidence: Final episode 58/58 served a real Astro SSR player page at /dramabox/play/{id}/58 with full 58-item episode grid and preconnect to hwztakavideoto.dramaboxdb.com. Zero lock/login/premium flags.
27/27 episodes as plain links /watch/nunomix/429457?ep=1..27; ep15 and ep27 return 200 with distinct proxied MP4 sources. Zero occurrences of koin/kredit/vip/premium/terkunci/login sitewide.
free.caveat: dramabox platform currently returns 502; nunomix works.

free.evidence: /api/DramaList/Drama/10903 returns all 36 episodes with is_locked/is_vip/price fields absent entirely from the schema. Zero HTML hits for terkunci/lock/vip/unlock/coin/koin.
free.caveat: Long-form Asian drama and films, not vertical-only.

free.evidence: Final episode 60/60 renders a full player plus complete 1-60 selector. Grep for coin|vip|premium|login|paywall returned only two Indonesian false positives: 'Daftar' (list) and 'Koin Raja Obat' (plot text).
?ep=105 on a 105-episode title returned a real episode-105 page with no redirect to signup/paywall. Site copy states free with no subscription and no account. Zero coin/vip/unlock markers.
No paywall markers on home, series, or watch pages. Each series collapses to a single entry labelled 'EP 1 / FULL EPISODES'.
free.risk: HIGH. Gridinsoft trust score 1/100, category 'Scam Website', 3 blacklist hits. No rights holder. Cloudflare-fronted; API tier currently down (503/523).

free.evidence: 69-episode title listed all 69 episodes with zero lock icons; EP1 and EP40 both load directly. Zero coin/VIP strings across 4 pages.
